description: Source code for DotpromptManager class that integrates LiteLLM's prompt management system, supporting .prompt files, prompt rendering, message conversion, and prompt management functions.

classes.name: DotpromptManager
classes.description: Manages prompts for LiteLLM using .prompt files, providing rendering, message conversion, and prompt management functionalities.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes DotpromptManager with optional prompt directory, file, data, and ID.

methods.name: prompt_manager
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the PromptManager instance.

methods.name: should_run_prompt_management
methods.description: Determines if prompt management should run based on prompt ID.

methods.name: _compile_prompt_helper
methods.description: Compiles a prompt from a .prompt file into a PromptManagementClient object.

methods.name: async_compile_prompt_helper
methods.description: Asynchronous version of _compile_prompt_helper, delegates to sync method.

methods.name: get_chat_completion_prompt
methods.description: Generates chat prompt using prompt management base method.

methods.name: async_get_chat_completion_prompt
methods.description: Asynchronous version delegating to base async method.

methods.name: _convert_to_messages
methods.description: Converts rendered prompt content into a list of chat messages, supporting role prefixes.

methods.name: _create_message
methods.description: Creates a message dict with role and content.

methods.name: _extract_optional_params
methods.description: Extracts optional parameters from prompt template metadata.

methods.name: set_prompt_directory
methods.description: Sets the prompt directory and resets prompt manager.

methods.name: reload_prompts
methods.description: Reloads all prompts from the directory.

methods.name: add_prompt_from_json
methods.description: Adds a prompt from JSON data.

methods.name: load_prompts_from_json
methods.description: Loads multiple prompts from JSON data.

methods.name: convert_prompt_file_to_json
methods.description: Converts a .prompt file to JSON format.
